notablePrerequisites: Curse of Clinging Webs attached to yourself.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Curse of Clinging Webs triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge and creating a 1/2 Spider token with reach.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spider token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
